summary.text: Will Morefield is a Republican member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 43rd District since 2010.
The district covers Bland, Buchanan and Tazewell counties and parts of Dickenson and Russell counties.
The House profile lists Will Morefield's occupation as small business owner.

paragraphs.text: Will Morefield was born in Bluefield, WV.
The profile lists a B.A.A.S. from Midwestern State University, TX (2007) and an M.B.A. from King College, TN (2013).
The profile lists the Tazewell Area Chamber of Commerce and the Coal and Energy Commission.
Will Morefield serves on the Counties, Cities and Towns, General Laws, and Appropriations committees.
